construction_notes.text: City status Decision Rendered, last updated 2026-10-23. The city's data does not say what the decision was.

City permit data for PLN-2026-33: demolition of an existing single-family residence and construction of nine three-story townhomes, with a Vesting Tentative Subdivision Map creating nine lots, under SB 1123. Filed under SB 330 preliminary application PLN-2025-169 (preliminary application date 12/03/2025). Status Decision Rendered, updated 2026-10-23. Case manager Stephen Rose.
The city's Starter Home Projects page gives a submittal date of 04/01/2026 for PLN-2026-33 and lists the zoning as Single-Family; the city's permit data gives a create date of 2026-03-19.
MLS 82025929 (Coldwell Banker Realty) marketed the site as a development opportunity, including a possible eight units under the city's starter home program.
